products.title: M89 Ground Barefoot - Silver
products.body_html:

  • Allowing you to adapt gradually to the barefoot feel while making every step feel natural and free.

  • Crafted with 100% recycled polyester made from used plastic bottles.

Ethically crafted in Portugal.

products.title: M89 Ground Off Track - Forest
products.body_html:
The M89 Ground is a minimalist barefoot walking shoe designed to mimic the natural way of walking, encouraging healthier posture, stronger feet, and a deeper connection with the ground. Ideal for barefoot beginners, its refined design and responsible materials make the transition to a more natural way of walking feel easy and approachable.

These zero-drop sneakers feature interchangeable insoles and an ultra-thin sole that keep you as close to the ground as possible, allowing you to adapt gradually to the barefoot feel while making every step feel natural and free.

  • Ideal for barefoot beginners
  • Allowing you to adapt gradually to the barefoot feel while making every step feel natural and free.
  • A sleeker feel, even for a barefoot shoe
  • Crafted with 100% recycled polyester made from used plastic bottles.
  • Lining made from soft bamboo and recycled PET sourced from post-consumer plastic waste.

For every pair sold, we fund the growth of seaweed in Canadian waters.

Ethically crafted in Portugal.

Our packaging is 100% recycled and recyclable.

Please note that due to the non-chemical dye used in the bamboo lining, slight color transfer may occur during the first wears.

products.title: JASON MARKK - 5.4oz Repel Spray
products.body_html:
At SAYE, we want your sneakers to last longer and always look as good as new. That’s why we’ve introduced Repel, a water-based protector free from harmful chemicals and “forever chemicals” (PFAS, PFOA, or PFCs). Its formula creates a durable, breathable, and completely invisible barrier that effectively protects against liquids and dirt.

This spray is safe for most absorbent materials: leather, suede, nubuck, canvas, cotton, nylon, knit, mesh, and more. Thanks to its fine, continuous mist delivery system, it covers large surfaces quickly and evenly without the need for polluting aerosols.

The bottle is 100% recyclable, and its label uses sustainable technology that makes plastic recycling easier, helping to maximize resource recovery.

An effective, transparent, and responsible protector so you can enjoy your SAYE sneakers for much longer.
